author: Inside Edition
description: Jonah is the mutt that watched as another pooch scarfed down a hot dog at a Marlins game last month. The beloved canine made his long-awaited return to the stadium and got the VIP treatment. Inside Edition producer Emma Keady was there for Jonah's big day. The dog and his human, Peter Silvera, were treated to a private suite complete with custom jerseys for both man and dog before Jonah's human threw the first pitch. Prior to leaving the stadium, Jonah got a ballpark hot dog all for himself.
title: Viral Dog, Jonah, Gets VIP Treatment at Marlins Game

author: Inside Edition
description: Kids found themselves trapped on a roof as flood waters were quickly rising below them. Allie and Rustin Woods are the parents of four of the brave little ones who huddled together on the roof in Iron County, Missouri. Rustin was first to notice the rising water. Allie says her training as a NICU nurse kicked in. The family was trapped for two hours. Boats eventually came and brought everyone to safety.
title: Family Trapped On Roof During Flood

author: Inside Edition
description: New details have emerged about the sightseer who was attacked by a rampaging bison. The incident started with the 2,000-pound bison charging through a campground. Video shows the beast appearing to settle down as a grandpa and grandson were coming by. The bison chased after them. The grandpa fled but the beast caught up with him and tossed him in the air. Professional photographer Mike MacLeod shot the video. The victim, Carl McDaniel, 63, suffered broken bones.
title: Rampaging Bison Attacks Grandpa, Tossing Him In Air

description: Actor Sam Niell has died. In 2023 Neil announced he was diagnosed with a rare form of Hodgkin's Lymphoma, but was cancer-free at the time of his death according to a statement posted on his Instagram account. His most notable role was in 1993's 'Jurassic Park' playing Dr. Alan Grant. He appeared in four of the franchise's seven films. Sam Neill was 78. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 'Jurassic Park' Actor Sam Neill Dead At 78
